benefits.name: $200 United TravelBank Credit
benefits.description: $200 in United TravelBank cash, issued at account opening and each account anniversary.
benefits.terms: Issued as United TravelBank cash, usable toward United flight purchases — not a general-purpose statement credit.

benefits.name: Renowned Hotels and Resorts Credit
benefits.description: Up to $150 in statement credits each anniversary year on prepaid stays booked through Renowned Hotels and Resorts for United Cardmembers.

eligibleMerchants: Renowned Hotels and Resorts for United Cardmembers

benefits.terms: Stay must be prepaid directly through the Renowned Hotels and Resorts program with the United Quest Card.

benefits.name: JSX Flight Credit
benefits.description: Up to $150 in statement credits each anniversary year on JSX flight bookings.

benefits.name: Rideshare Credit
benefits.description: Up to $100 per year in rideshare statement credits, disbursed monthly: $8 per month January through November and $12 in December.
benefits.terms: Requires enrollment. Paid as $8/month January-November and $12 in December, totaling up to $100 per calendar year.

benefits.name: Avis and Budget Car Rental Credit
benefits.description: Up to $80 per year in United TravelBank cash for Avis or Budget rentals — $40 per rental, up to two rentals annually.
benefits.terms: Issued as United TravelBank cash at $40 per qualifying rental, maximum two rentals per year.

benefits.name: Instacart Credit
benefits.description: Up to $180 per year in Instacart statement credits, issued as one $10 and one $5 credit each month.
benefits.terms: Requires enrollment. Promotional benefit available through Dec. 31, 2027 per current terms; confirm this end date is still current before relying on it.

benefits.name: Complimentary Instacart+ Membership
benefits.description: Three months of complimentary Instacart+ membership, then 50% off the annual membership rate.
benefits.terms: Requires activation. Promotional benefit available through Dec. 31, 2027 per current terms; confirm this end date is still current before relying on it.

benefits.name: Anniversary Award Flight Discount
benefits.description: A 10,000-mile discount on a United award flight redemption at each account anniversary.
benefits.terms: Applied as a mileage rebate after redeeming miles for an eligible United flight.

benefits.name: Award Flight Discount After $20,000 Annual Spend
benefits.description: An additional 10,000-mile award flight discount after spending $20,000 on purchases in a calendar year.
benefits.terms: Requires $20,000 in purchases in a calendar year. Maximum one per calendar year.

benefits.name: Economy Plus Seat Upgrades After $40,000 Annual Spend
benefits.description: Two global Economy Plus seat upgrades after spending $40,000 on purchases in a calendar year.
benefits.terms: Requires $40,000 in purchases in a calendar year.

benefits.name: First and Second Checked Bags Free
benefits.description: Free first and second checked bags on United-operated flights for the primary cardmember and one companion on the same reservation.
benefits.terms: Ticket must be purchased with the United Quest Card. The companion need not be a cardmember, only on the same reservation.

benefits.name: Priority Boarding
benefits.description: Priority boarding on United- and United Express-operated flights.

benefits.name: 1,000 Bonus Premier Qualifying Points
benefits.description: 1,000 Card Bonus Premier Qualifying Points (PQP) awarded annually toward MileagePlus Premier status.
benefits.terms: Posts within 8 weeks of Feb. 1 each year.

benefits.name: Premier Qualifying Points from Spend
benefits.description: Earn 1 Premier Qualifying Point per $20 spent, up to 18,000 PQP per year.

benefits.name: Global Entry, TSA PreCheck, or NEXUS Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit of up to $120 for a Global Entry, TSA PreCheck, or NEXUS application fee.

benefits.name: 25% Back on United Inflight and Club Purchases
benefits.description: 25% back as a statement credit on food, beverages, and Wi-Fi purchased aboard United-operated flights, and on United Club premium drinks.
benefits.terms: Rebate is 25% of each qualifying purchase, with no fixed annual dollar cap stated.

benefits.name: Award Flight Pricing Discount
benefits.description: Save 10% or more on United award flights booked with miles; 15% or more for MileagePlus Premier members.

benefits.name: Trip Cancellation & Interruption Insurance
benefits.description: Reimbursement up to $1,500 per covered traveler and $6,000 per trip for prepaid, non-refundable travel expenses.

benefits.name: Trip Delay Reimbursement
benefits.description: Up to $500 per covered traveler for reasonable expenses when a trip is delayed.

benefits.name: Baggage Delay Insurance
benefits.description: Up to $100 a day for up to 3 days for essential purchases when checked luggage is delayed.

benefits.name: Lost Luggage Reimbursement
benefits.description: Up to $3,000 per covered traveler for lost, damaged, or stolen checked or carry-on luggage.

benefits.name: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver
benefits.description: Primary coverage for damage or theft on most rental cars, up to $60,000.
benefits.terms: Primary coverage. Decline the rental company's collision coverage to activate.

benefits.name: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers eligible new purchases for 120 days against damage or theft, up to $10,000 per item.

benefits.name: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.description: Adds one year to eligible U.S. manufacturer warranties of three years or less.

earningRates.terms: 4x miles from the card on United purchases. On eligible United flights this stacks with 6x base MileagePlus miles on the primary cardmember's fare for 10x total.
Prepaid stays booked through Renowned Hotels and Resorts for United Cardmembers.
All other travel purchases outside United.
